recordedFrom: a derivation memoized by the part of its scope it reads, after Lift offered only types it could include, after unat's order lemmas and equality decision added (NT1, 2026-10-28), after a projection's or an eliminator's argument taken to its weak head in one step, after an operator checked before its operands (L2.10j), after nat's zero test, multiplicative cancellation and trichotomy added (2026-10-05), after nat's predecessor, cancellation and rearrangements, after nat's laws of multiplication, after one nat module (2026-10-05), after 54ab56f + known-signature application elaboration (L4.1a)
method: tests/driver-trace.mjs run on the implementation tree. Every instruction the driver issued with its operands and result, and every weak-head query with its budget and answer, in order, hashed. Source-defined Nat uses signature instances, constructors and generic eliminators. Rewriting library/naturals add with match and an explicit Nat result removes motive applications from its public type, changing the derivation trace. The inner case analysis of le is a match, which names the predecessor in its clause instead of `as j`; that adds 18 issued instructions and no weak-head query. Dropping unused `as` names alone leaves the trace unchanged. The eight fixture declarations still check. L4.1a reads each parameter's type from the function's type and asks the kernel for each argument's derivation, instead of the growing application's type: the elaboration's queries intern other terms first, which renumbers the handles the admissions' instructions take. Issued, heads and checked are unchanged. The laws of multiplication added to nat (nat_mul_zero through nat_mul_assoc) are imported and derived too: issued 3493 to 8884 and heads 487 to 943; the eight fixture declarations' own derivations are unchanged. nat's predecessor, nat_succ_injective, nat_add_cancel, nat_add_left_comm and nat_add_interchange, imported and derived too: issued 8884 to 10650 and heads 943 to 983. nat_is_zero, nat_zero_ne_succ, nat_mul_cancel, Trichotomy and nat_trichotomy, imported and derived too: issued 10650 to 15139 and heads 983 to 1163. L2.10j checks an arithmetic operator's selection before reading its operands, so its left operand is translated once rather than twice; the second translation's queries no longer intern terms first, which renumbers handles. Issued, heads and checked are unchanged. A projection's or an eliminator's argument that would unfold a definition or contract a lambda is taken to its weak head normal form in one whnf step (scrutineeStep), rather than step by step: issued 15139 to 15010 and heads 1163 to 1142; the eight fixture declarations still check. Reading a focused subterm in one call and the normal form budget of a quarter of a million steps leave the trace unchanged. unat_decide, which moved from hlevels, and unat's order lemmas unat_le_zero through unat_add_positive (NT1 of the archive retirement), imported and derived too: issued 15010 to 23423 and heads 1142 to 1348; the eight fixture declarations still check. A conversion that fails is no longer offered to Lift, with the side read for it, unless both types are universes or Π, Σ or level Π types ending in universes, as only those can Lift include one in the other: the fixture's failing conversions issue neither, issued 23423 to 23407; heads and checked are unchanged. A derivation is memoized by the part of its scope it reads (InstructionDriver.narrow): the entries of its free variables, every live dimension, the faces and the dimensions the scope's types mention, so a subterm met again under binders it does not mention is not derived again (docs/reports/driver-derivation-sharing.md): issued 23407 to 14125; heads and checked are unchanged, and the eight fixture declarations still check.
